facts.fact: ANID's own page says the agency was created by law n° 2020-009 of 10 September 2020 on biometric identification of natural persons in Togo, as amended by law n° 2022-010; the page is undated and gives no date for the law's status, so as_of is the law's own date.
facts.system: Law n° 2020-009 of 10 September 2020 on biometric identification of natural persons, as amended by law n° 2022-010

systems.system: Social Register of Individuals and Households (RSPM)
systems.country_label: Registre social des personnes et des ménages

note: No cover fact: the page lists ANID's functions (registration, unique number, authentication) but does not say the law sets up the register or number, and names no dated implementing instrument.
